section: Part I, Chapter 18 — Karav, Naga, Nagash (Drawing Near)
subtitle: דלאלהֵ אלחאירין — The Guide of the Perplexed
author: Moses Maimonides (1138–1204)
intro: Three verbs — karav ('approach'), naga ('touch'), and nagash ('draw near') — each bear two senses: nearness and contact in place, and the joining of knowledge to its object, a nearness of apprehension figured as one body approaching another. Wherever Scripture sets any of them between God and a creature, only the second sense is meant; for once corporeality is removed, place falls away and with it all nearness, distance, contact, and succession. 'The Lord is near to all who call upon Him' (Ps 145:18) is a nearness of knowing, not of place. Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a gloss; dotted words are key terms.

terms.gloss: approaching, touching, drawing near (Hebrew קְרִיבָה / נְגִיעָה / נְגִישָׁה)
terms.note: Three nouns, each equivocal: a nearness or contact in place, and a nearness of apprehension — knowledge joining to its object.

terms.gloss: the joining of knowledge to its object
terms.note: The second, figurative sense: the knower draws near to what he had not apprehended before, as a body draws near a body — not a nearness of place.
Once corporeality is removed from God, place falls away, and with it every nearness, distance, joining, separation, contact, or succession.

terms.gloss: nearness to Him is by apprehending Him
terms.note: It makes no difference whether one stands at earth's center or atop the ninth sphere: nearness to God is by apprehending Him, and distance from Him belongs to one who is ignorant of Him — and these admit of vast degrees.

aligned.ja: אלג'ז אלאול · אלפצל אלת'אמן עשר — קרב ונגע ונגש
aligned.en: Part One · Chapter Eighteen — Karav, Naga, Nagash

aligned.ja: קרב ונגע ונגש. הד'ה אלת'לת'ה אסמא — אעני קריבה ונגיעה ונגישה — קד תכון למעני אלדנו ואלקרב פי אלמכאן, וקד תכון למעני אתצאל אלעלם באלמעלום, פכאנה שבה בקרב ג'סם מן ג'סם.
aligned.en: Karav, naga, and nagash. These three nouns — approaching, touching, and drawing near — may bear the sense of nearness and proximity in place, and may bear the sense of the joining of knowledge to its object, as though it were likened to the nearness of one body to another.

pairs.en: Karav, naga, and nagash
These three nouns
approaching, touching, and drawing near

pairs.ja: קד תכון למעני אלדנו ואלקרב פי אלמכאן
pairs.en: may bear the sense of nearness and proximity in place

pairs.ja: וקד תכון למעני אתצאל אלעלם באלמעלום
pairs.en: and may bear the sense of the joining of knowledge to its object

pairs.ja: פכאנה שבה בקרב ג'סם מן ג'סם
pairs.en: as though it were likened to the nearness of one body to another

aligned.ja: אמא מעני קריבה אלאול, והו אלקרב פי אלמכאן: כאשר קרב אל המחנה, ופרעה הקריב.
aligned.en: As for the first sense of 'approaching,' which is nearness in place: 'as he drew near to the camp' (Exod 32:19); 'and Pharaoh drew near' (Exod 14:10).

pairs.en: As for the first sense of 'approaching,'
which is nearness in place
as he drew near to the camp
and Pharaoh drew near

aligned.ja: ואלנגיעה מענאהא אלאול דנו ג'סם בג'סם: ותגע לרגליו, ויגע על פי. ומעני נגישה אלאול אקדאם שכ'ץ עלי שכ'ץ וחרכתה אליה: ויגש אליו יהודה.
aligned.en: And 'touching' — its first sense is the contact of one body with another: 'and she touched his feet' (Exod 4:25); 'and he touched my mouth' (Isa 6:7). And the first sense of 'drawing near' is one person advancing upon another and moving toward him: 'then Judah came near to him' (Gen 44:18).

pairs.ja: ואלנגיעה מענאהא אלאול דנו ג'סם בג'סם
pairs.en: And 'touching' — its first sense is the contact of one body with another
and she touched his feet
and he touched my mouth

pairs.ja: ומעני נגישה אלאול אקדאם שכ'ץ עלי שכ'ץ וחרכתה אליה
pairs.en: And the first sense of 'drawing near' is one person advancing upon another and moving toward him
then Judah came near to him

aligned.ja: ומעני הד'ה אלת'לת'ה אסמא אלת'אני הו אתצאל עלם ודנו אדראך, לא דנו מכאן. קאל מן אלנגיעה פי מעני אתצאל אלעלם: כי נגע אל השמים משפטה.
aligned.en: And the second sense of these three nouns is the joining of knowledge and the nearness of apprehension — not nearness of place. Of 'touching,' in the sense of the joining of knowledge, He said: 'for her judgment reaches unto heaven' (Jer 51:9).

pairs.ja: ומעני הד'ה אלת'לת'ה אסמא אלת'אני הו אתצאל עלם ודנו אדראך
pairs.en: And the second sense of these three nouns is the joining of knowledge and the nearness of apprehension
not nearness of place

pairs.ja: קאל מן אלנגיעה פי מעני אתצאל אלעלם
pairs.en: Of 'touching,' in the sense of the joining of knowledge, He said
for her judgment reaches unto heaven

aligned.ja: וקיל מן אלקריבה: והדבר אשר יקשה מכם תקריבון אלי — כאנה יקול תעלמוני בה. פקד אסתעמל פי אעלאם במעלום.
aligned.en: And of 'approaching' it is said: 'the cause that is too hard for you, bring unto me' (Deut 1:17) — as if to say, 'inform me of it.' So it is used for making something known about an object of knowledge.

pairs.en: And of 'approaching' it is said

pairs.ja: והדבר אשר יקשה מכם תקריבון אלי
pairs.en: the cause that is too hard for you, bring unto me
as if to say, 'inform me of it.'
So it is used for making something known about an object of knowledge

aligned.ja: וקיל מן אלנגישה: ויגש אברהם ויאמר — והו כאן פי חאל אלוחי ואלסבאת אלנבוי כמא סיבין. יען כי נגש העם הזה בפיו ובשפתיו כבדוני.
aligned.en: And of 'drawing near' it is said: 'and Abraham drew near and said' (Gen 18:23) — and he was in a state of revelation, in the prophetic trance, as will be explained. 'Forasmuch as this people draw near with their mouth, and with their lips do honor Me' (Isa 29:13).

pairs.en: And of 'drawing near' it is said
and Abraham drew near and said

pairs.ja: והו כאן פי חאל אלוחי ואלסבאת אלנבוי כמא סיבין
pairs.en: and he was in a state of revelation, in the prophetic trance, as will be explained

pairs.ja: יען כי נגש העם הזה בפיו ובשפתיו כבדוני
pairs.en: Forasmuch as this people draw near with their mouth, and with their lips do honor Me

aligned.ja: פכל לשון קריבה או נגישה תג'דהא ג'את פי כתב אלנבוה בין אללה תעאלי ובין מכ'לוק מן אלמכ'לוקאת, פהי כלהא מן הד'א אלמעני אלאכ'יר, לאן אללה תעאלי ליס הו ג'סמא כמא סיתברהן לך פי הד'ה אלמקאלה.
aligned.en: So every expression of 'approaching' or 'drawing near' that you find in the books of prophecy between God, may He be exalted, and one of His creatures, is wholly of this last sense; for God, may He be exalted, is not a body, as will be demonstrated to you in this treatise.

pairs.ja: פכל לשון קריבה או נגישה תג'דהא ג'את פי כתב אלנבוה
pairs.en: So every expression of 'approaching' or 'drawing near' that you find in the books of prophecy

pairs.ja: בין אללה תעאלי ובין מכ'לוק מן אלמכ'לוקאת
pairs.en: between God, may He be exalted, and one of His creatures

pairs.ja: פהי כלהא מן הד'א אלמעני אלאכ'יר
pairs.en: is wholly of this last sense

pairs.ja: לאן אללה תעאלי ליס הו ג'סמא כמא סיתברהן לך פי הד'ה אלמקאלה
pairs.en: for God, may He be exalted, is not a body, as will be demonstrated to you in this treatise

aligned.ja: פלא הו תעאלי ידנו ולא יקרב מן שי, ולא שי מן אלאשיא יקרב מנה או ידנו בה תעאלי, אד' בארתפאע אלג'סמאניה ירתפע אלמכאן ויבטל כל קרב ודנו או בעד או אתצאל או אנפצאל או תמאס או תתאלי.
aligned.en: So He, may He be exalted, neither comes near nor approaches anything, nor does any thing approach or come near to Him; for with the removal of corporeality, place is removed, and there lapses every nearness and proximity, distance, joining, separation, contact, or succession.

pairs.ja: פלא הו תעאלי ידנו ולא יקרב מן שי
pairs.en: So He, may He be exalted, neither comes near nor approaches anything

pairs.ja: ולא שי מן אלאשיא יקרב מנה או ידנו בה תעאלי
pairs.en: nor does any thing approach or come near to Him
for with the removal of corporeality, place is removed

pairs.ja: ויבטל כל קרב ודנו או בעד או אתצאל או אנפצאל או תמאס או תתאלי
pairs.en: and there lapses every nearness and proximity, distance, joining, separation, contact, or succession

aligned.ja: ומא אראך תשך ולא ילבס עליך קולה: קרוב י״י לכל קוראיו, קרבת אלהים יחפצון, קרבת אלהים לי טוב — אן הד'ה כלהא קרב עלם, אעני אדראך עלמי, לא קרב מכאן.
aligned.en: I do not think you will doubt, nor will it confuse you, that His saying — 'the Lord is near to all who call upon Him' (Ps 145:18); 'they delight in the nearness of God' (Isa 58:2); 'the nearness of God is good for me' (Ps 73:28) — all of these are a nearness of knowledge, I mean a nearness of apprehension, not a nearness of place.

pairs.ja: ומא אראך תשך ולא ילבס עליך קולה
pairs.en: I do not think you will doubt, nor will it confuse you, that His saying
the Lord is near to all who call upon Him
they delight in the nearness of God
the nearness of God is good for me

pairs.ja: אן הד'ה כלהא קרב עלם, אעני אדראך עלמי, לא קרב מכאן
pairs.en: all of these are a nearness of knowledge, I mean a nearness of apprehension, not a nearness of place

aligned.ja: וכד'לך קולה: קרובים אליו, קרב אתה ושמע, ונגש משה לבדו אל י״י והם לא יגשו — אלא אן תריד אן תג'על מא קיל פי משה ונגש אנה יקרב מן אלמוצ'ע מן אלג'בל אלד'י חל פיה אלנור, אעני כבוד י״י, פלך ד'לך.
aligned.en: And likewise His saying: 'who have God near to them' (Deut 4:7); 'go near and hear' (Deut 5:27); 'and Moses alone shall draw near unto the Lord, but they shall not draw near' (Exod 24:2) — unless you wish to take what is said of Moses, 'and he drew near,' as his approaching the place on the mountain where the light, that is, the glory of the Lord, had alighted; that is open to you.

pairs.en: And likewise His saying
who have God near to them
go near and hear

pairs.ja: ונגש משה לבדו אל י״י והם לא יגשו
pairs.en: and Moses alone shall draw near unto the Lord, but they shall not draw near

pairs.ja: אלא אן תריד אן תג'על מא קיל פי משה ונגש
pairs.en: unless you wish to take what is said of Moses, 'and he drew near,'

pairs.ja: אנה יקרב מן אלמוצ'ע מן אלג'בל אלד'י חל פיה אלנור, אעני כבוד י״י
pairs.en: as his approaching the place on the mountain where the light, that is, the glory of the Lord, had alighted
that is open to you

aligned.ja: לכן תמסך באלאצל אן לא פרק בין כון אלשכ'ץ פי מרכז אלארץ' או פי אעלי אלפלך אלתאסע — לו אמכן ד'לך — פאנה לם יבעד מן אללה הנא ולא קרב מנה הנאך, בל אלקרב מנה תעאלי באדראכה, ואלבעד ענה למן ג'הלה.
aligned.en: But hold fast to the principle that there is no difference between a person's being at the center of the earth or at the summit of the ninth sphere — were that possible — for he is no farther from God in the one place nor nearer to Him in the other; rather, nearness to Him, may He be exalted, is by apprehending Him, and distance from Him belongs to one who is ignorant of Him.

pairs.en: But hold fast to the principle

pairs.ja: אן לא פרק בין כון אלשכ'ץ פי מרכז אלארץ' או פי אעלי אלפלך אלתאסע
pairs.en: that there is no difference between a person's being at the center of the earth or at the summit of the ninth sphere
were that possible

pairs.ja: פאנה לם יבעד מן אללה הנא ולא קרב מנה הנאך
pairs.en: for he is no farther from God in the one place nor nearer to Him in the other
rather, nearness to Him, may He be exalted, is by apprehending Him
and distance from Him belongs to one who is ignorant of Him

aligned.ja: ויתפאצ'ל אלקרב ואלבעד מן הד'ה אלג'הה תפאצ'לא כת'ירא ג'דא. וסאבין פי פצל מן פצול הד'ה אלמקאלה כיף הו אלתפאצ'ל פי אלאדראך.
aligned.en: And nearness and distance in this respect admit of very great gradation. I shall explain, in one of the chapters of this treatise, how gradation in apprehension comes about.

pairs.ja: ויתפאצ'ל אלקרב ואלבעד מן הד'ה אלג'הה תפאצ'לא כת'ירא ג'דא
pairs.en: And nearness and distance in this respect admit of very great gradation

pairs.ja: וסאבין פי פצל מן פצול הד'ה אלמקאלה כיף הו אלתפאצ'ל פי אלאדראך
pairs.en: I shall explain, in one of the chapters of this treatise, how gradation in apprehension comes about

aligned.ja: אמא קולה: גע בהרים ויעשנו — יעני בה אוצל אמרך להא עלי ג'ההֵ אלמת'ל, כמא קאל וגע אל עצמו — יעני אחל אפתך בה.
aligned.en: As for His saying 'touch the mountains, and they shall smoke' (Ps 144:5) — He means by it 'let Your command reach them,' by way of figure, just as it says 'and touch his bone' (Job 2:5) — meaning 'let Your affliction alight upon him.'

pairs.en: As for His saying
touch the mountains, and they shall smoke

pairs.ja: יעני בה אוצל אמרך להא עלי ג'ההֵ אלמת'ל
pairs.en: He means by it 'let Your command reach them,' by way of figure
just as it says 'and touch his bone'
meaning 'let Your affliction alight upon him.'

aligned.ja: וכד'לך אלנגיעה ומא יתצרף מנהא תעתברהא פי כל מכאן בחסבה, פתארה יראד בהא דנו ג'סם בג'סם, ותארה אתצאל עלם ואדראך אמר מא, פכאן מדרך אלאמר אלד'י לם יכן ידרכה קבל קד קרב מן שי כאן בעידא ענה. פאפהם הד'א.
aligned.en: And likewise 'touching' and its derivatives: consider each according to its place — at one time it intends the contact of body with body, at another the joining of knowledge and the apprehension of some matter, so that the one who apprehends a thing he had not apprehended before has, as it were, drawn near to something he had been far from. Understand this.

pairs.en: And likewise 'touching' and its derivatives: consider each according to its place
